reviews.review: Do not buy this game. Expansion are literally more expensive than the base game, and game has a stupid card grinding system! Haha.

Back 4 Blood is a cooperative first-person shooter that takes place in a world overrun by a deadly virus. Players take on the role of "Cleaners," a group of survivors tasked with fighting off waves of infected monsters as they try to complete various objectives.

One of the standout features of Back 4 Blood is its intense, fast-paced gameplay. The game is designed to be played in short bursts, with each mission lasting around 20-30 minutes. The action is intense and the infected are relentless, making for a thrilling experience.

The game also features a variety of different weapons and abilities that players can use to take on the infected threat. Each character class has their own unique abilities and loadouts, allowing players to tailor their playstyle to their preferences.

In terms of presentation, Back 4 Blood is top-notch. The graphics are impressive, with detailed character models and environments. The sound design is also excellent, with the creepy sound effects and music adding to the atmosphere.

Overall, Back 4 Blood is a great game for fans of cooperative shooters and the zombie genre. Its fast-paced gameplay, varied character classes, and immersive presentation make it a must-play for anyone looking for a thrilling, cooperative shooter experience.
